text: Finding submitted: this is a documentation issue in README.md's "Running locally" section, which fails to mention the `S3_ENDPOINT` setting needed for MinIO-based local setups.

input.title: Document S3_ENDPOINT requirement for MinIO in README
input.body:
File: README.md

In the 'Running locally' section (step 2 or 3), add a line noting that when using MinIO (or any non-AWS S3-compatible store) you must set S3_ENDPOINT (e.g. http://localhost:9000) and create the bucket beforehand. Without this, uploads default to AWS and fail with ENOTFOUND.
